The Load Data wizard: its steps, navigation and Finish

Source: R/wizard-panels.R
wizard_steps_ui.Rd

The frame of the Load Data wizard. It shows the row of steps, the page of the current step, and a footer with Back and Continue buttons, and it decides which step the user may open (compute_step_states()). A newly loaded Excel or Stata file is walked through step by step: a step opens once the user has moved on from the one before it, and a required step must be complete before Continue is enabled. An optional step the user has not touched offers "Skip" in place of "Continue". The last step's button is Finish. A saved dataset (.rds) skips the walkthrough and opens on the summary page (wizard_landing_ui()), from which any step can be opened for editing.

Usage

wizard_steps_ui(id)

wizard_steps_server(
  id,
  i18n,
  cache,
  requires_walkthrough,
  panels,
  source_path,
  active,
  step_defs = wizard_step_defs
)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection, or NULL when no dataset is loaded.

requires_walkthrough

A reactive that returns TRUE when the loaded file must be walked through step by step (an Excel or Stata file) and FALSE when it is a saved dataset (.rds). upload_box_server() returns it.

panels

The pages of the steps: a list with one element per step of step_defs. Each element is a list with key (the step's key) and ui (the step's page, as Shiny tags).

source_path

A reactive that returns the path Finish saves the dataset next to, a string, or NULL. upload_box_server() returns it.

active

A reactive that returns TRUE while the Load Data screen is the page shown.

step_defs

The wizard's steps, a list with the structure of wizard_step_defs, which is the default.

Value

wizard_steps_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: the placeholder the server fills with the wizard or the summary page. wizard_steps_server() returns a list with two elements:

  • edit_mode: a reactive that is TRUE when a finished dataset is being edited;

  • current_step: a reactive value that holds the key of the current step.

Details

Finish. On a dataset whose sheets are not merged yet (cache()$wizard_parts), and whose blocking quality checks pass, Finish:

  • merges the sheets with merge_and_standardize() for the app's indicator group, adds a key per admin level 1 area, and saves the result with cache()$set_countdown_data();

  • adds the same keys to the saved survey and shapefile name mappings (cache()$set_survey_mapping(), cache()$set_map_mapping());

  • marks the dataset as finished with cache()$set_quality_confirmed(TRUE);

  • sets where the dataset is saved, with cache()$set_cache_path(): the folder of source_path() and the name cd_saved_copy_name() gives;

  • keeps the quality check results with cache()$set_wizard_quality_results(), then removes the unmerged sheets with cache()$clear_wizard_parts().

When the merge fails, an error notification shows and the wizard stays on the last step. Otherwise the wizard shows the summary page. A dataset that has no unmerged sheets (one loaded from a Stata file) is merged already: Finish marks it finished and sets where it is saved, the same way.

Editing. A dataset that is finished (loaded from a saved copy, or cache()$quality_confirmed is TRUE) is in edit mode. The footer then has a button back to the summary page and a button that opens the Reporting Rate page ("reporting_rate"). Coming back to the Load Data screen from another page shows the summary page again when cache()$quality_confirmed is TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in the ui of the Load Data screen
wizard_steps_ui(ns("wizard"))

# in its server: one page per step of wizard_step_defs, built with the screen's own ns()
upload <- upload_box_server("upload_box", i18n, cdsuite_file = NA_character_)
panels <- list(
  list(key = "upload", ui = upload_box_ui(ns("upload_box"), i18n)),
  list(key = "quality", ui = data_quality_ui(ns("data_quality"), i18n)),
  list(key = "survey_files", ui = survey_upload_ui(ns("survey_upload"), i18n)),
  list(key = "national_rates", ui = national_rates_ui(ns("national_rates"), i18n)),
  list(key = "shapefile", ui = shapefile_step_ui(ns("shapefile_step"), i18n)),
  list(key = "survey_mapping", ui = map_survey_ui(ns("map_survey"), i18n)),
  list(key = "map_mapping", ui = map_shapefile_ui(ns("map_shapefile"), i18n))
)
wizard <- wizard_steps_server(
  "wizard", i18n = i18n, cache = upload$cache,
  requires_walkthrough = upload$requires_walkthrough, panels = panels,
  source_path = upload$source_path, active = active
)
observe(message("On step ", wizard$current_step()))
} # }
